conviction_note: Pre-revenue name with no option chain; abs_move 9.0 from its own 8.65% median reaction (prints of -12.3%, 0.0%, +5.0%, -16.1%), p_up 43 because three things lean the same way: this name sells its prints (the 07-16 print announced CAD 78.3m cash and still fell 12.3% on a one-quarter prototype slip), a fresh $50m ATM has been live since 09-04 into a falling tape, and the bar is a single sponsored Zacks estimate. None of these is an unpriced company-level number, so the lean stays mild. The findings sum (-0.9) and the scaled number (-1.26) agree in sign and size.
bar: Zacks SCR (sponsored, single source) fiscal Q1 2027 (Aug) EPS estimate of CAD -0.11 per share, https://s27.q4cdn.com/906368049/files/News/2026/Zacks_SCR_Research_07172026_HOVR_Lantier.pdf (2026-07-17). No second agreeing estimate source and no company guide, so the bar counts as unsourced and every finding is capped small. The stock does not trade on EPS; the line that matters is the prototype timeline (company: 'on track to begin initial testing in Q1 calendar 2027', https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001930021/000121390026078500/ea029810101ex99-1.htm).
positioning_check: FINRA via MarketBeat (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/HOVR/short-interest/, published 2026-09-24): 2,726,039 shares short at the 2026-09-15 settlement, 4.57% of float, 4.4 days to cover. This is down from a 7.2% peak (05-15) and the 3.05M at 07-15, so the short is not crowded. No option market (baseline options.status no_options_market), so there is no skew to read. Tape: -8.1% over 5 days, -5.3% over 20 days, -60.7% from the 52-week high, and +27.9% off the low.

findings.finding: A new $50m 'Capital on Demand' ATM with JonesTrading went live on 2026-09-04 off a $200m shelf (S-3 filed 08-28), and the 424B5 repeats a going-concern doubt beyond 12 months. This runs against the sponsored analyst's July view that no meaningful issuance would come before the end of fiscal 2028. The 10-Q cover will show how many shares the ATM has sold since 08-27 (67,123,941 then).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Two May 2026 RDOs (~US$45m at $2.16 and $2.51) were followed by a slide from $2.92 at 05-29 to $1.67 at 08-31 (MarketBeat SI table record-date prices). The 07-16 print, whose headline was the CAD 78.3m cash, fell 12.28%.
findings.why_not_priced: The ATM itself is public, and the stock has slid from $1.75 (09-24) to $1.535, which is partly that. What nobody can see yet is the amount sold: no 8-K is required for ATM sales, and the share count is unobservable until the 10-Q cover. If the market had priced heavy usage, short interest would be building into the print; it fell from 2.82M to 2.73M.
findings.independence: Rule 4 asks what the money buys. Here it buys program build-out, not survival: the company says >24 months of liquidity on CAD 78.3m (July release), and the careers page shows 17 open engineering and program roles against a headcount of 56. So the sign is a dilution overhang, not distress, and the finding is sized small. Zacks's July note (https://s27.q4cdn.com/906368049/files/News/2026/Zacks_SCR_Research_07172026_HOVR_Lantier.pdf) gives the 'no issuance till FY2028' expectation that the ATM contradicts.

findings.finding: The prototype timeline already slipped once, at the last print (assembly from end-CY2026 to 'spring 2027', 'initial testing Q1 calendar 2027'), and that print fell 12.3%. Since then the company has announced LOIs (V-Star, Great Lakes Helicopter) and coupon-level icing tests, but no arrival of a major aerostructure (RAMPF fuselage, NAI wing) that the schedule depends on.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-07-16: the timeline slipped about one quarter and the stock fell 12.28% despite a CAD 78.3m cash headline (Zacks: 'relatively minor adjustment'). On 2026-01-14 the company reaffirmed 'assembly by year-end 2026' and the stock rose 5.03%.
findings.why_not_priced: A reiteration is priced; a second slip is not. In Q2 the CEO said assembly depended on the major aerostructures arriving 'over the summer and into the autumn'. No press release since 07-16 reports one arriving, while lesser items got releases. If the market expected a clean reiteration it would not be at -8% over five days with the ATM live. This rests on an absence, so it stays small and two-sided.
findings.independence: The Aviation Week story on the spring-2027 completion (https://aviationweek.com/business-aviation/aircraft-propulsion/horizon-targets-spring-2027-completion-full-scale-cavorite-x7) is the same slip seen from a different source. AIN's 2026-09-02 icing story (https://www.ainonline.com/aviation-news/futureflight/2026-09-02/horizon-begins-icing-tests-cavorite-x7-evtol) shows coupon-level testing only. There is no direct evidence of a new slip; this is inference.

findings.finding: Warrant liabilities are remeasured through earnings (the 10-K shows a CAD 10.8m FY2026 fair-value loss on 12.07m $11.50 warrants plus the RDO warrants as the stock rose). With the stock down from $2.92 (05-29) to $1.67 (08-31) in the quarter, Q1 should carry a non-cash gain that narrows reported net loss against a CAD -0.11 bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2025-10-10 Q1 print missed EPS (-0.11 against -0.08) and fell 16.08%, but that headline was the same kind of noise. On 2025-01 (FY2025 Q2) EPS was +0.80 CAD per Zacks, almost certainly a remeasurement. The non-cash line has no measured payoff on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: A sponsored EPS estimate of -0.11 implies roughly CAD 7m of net loss, about the cash opex run rate, so it appears to exclude remeasurement. A headline EPS 'beat' from a non-cash gain would show on automated wires. It is below operating income with no path to the timeline or the multiple, so it is sized at a fraction.
findings.independence: The quarter-end prices come from a different source, the MarketBeat FINRA table ($2.92 at 05-29, $1.67 at 08-31). The warrant's own price series could not be sourced reliably, so the size of the gain is an inference.

findings.finding: The careers page lists 17 distinct open roles (24 postings, including bilingual Montreal engineering roles) against the 56 headcount stated in July, consistent with the plan of >100 by summer 2027. Q1 opex should step up from the Q4 run rate (Zacks: Q4 R&D CAD 3.6m, cash burn CAD 4.7m).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No print on this name has visibly turned on opex. Zacks noted Q4 R&D 20% below its estimate, and the stock still fell 12.3% on the timeline.
findings.why_not_priced: Higher burn is guided by the company and expected by Zacks, so this lands inside what the market was told. Sized near zero.
findings.independence: July release: headcount 56, >100 by summer 2027 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001930021/000121390026078500/ea029810101ex99-1.htm). It shares the corroboration role in finding 1 but is a separate fact (opex against funding).

outside_window.finding: First full-scale Cavorite X7 assembly and start of ground testing, targeted spring / Q1 calendar 2027.

eVTOL peer read-through for early October 2026: no dated sector move found

rejected_candidates.candidate: V-Star Powered Lift Aviation LOI for up to 100 aircraft / $600m (07-21) and Great Lakes Helicopter LOI (09-29) as positives the business update will recap
rejected_candidates.detail: Public before the print and already reacted to (+20.2% on 07-21, 0.0% on 09-29). Their only bearing on this print is as context in the timeline finding, so they are merged there rather than filed separately.

baseline_tension: No skew exists. The mild negative agrees with the 5-day run-up (-8.1%) and with the name's history of selling prints (1 of 4 up), so it is partly priced, which is why p_up sits at 43 and not lower. Short interest at 4.6% of float poses no squeeze threat to a negative.
lessons_applied: Rule 4 (financing is a question): the ATM buys program build-out with >24 months of runway and hiring corroborating the use, so it is overhang and not distress; shrunk from -0.8 to -0.5.
Rule 6 (verify the bar): the CAD -0.11 bar has one sponsored source, so all findings are capped small. The warrant-gain one-off went from +0.4 to +0.2, and print_vs_bar from +15 to +10.
Rule 5 (absence is not a cause): the timeline finding rests partly on the absence of an aerostructure-arrival release; shrunk from -0.7 to -0.5 and kept two-sided.
Rule 2 (one-offs as one-offs): the warrant remeasurement is filed as one_off at a fraction.
Rule 6 (inside the guide): the hiring/opex finding lands inside guided burn; cut from -0.2 to -0.1.
Rule 7: short interest checked (4.6% of float, 4.4 DTC), not crowded, so negatives were not shrunk for squeeze risk. p_up moved 42 to 43 for the unsourced bar.
